newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai PTT unit opens more Chinese stations.
newsitem.headline: Thai PTT unit opens more Chinese stations.

text.p: State-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) said on Tuesday its Chinese joint venture opened three new petrol service stations in Guangdong province.
A PTT statement quoted PTT governor Pala Sookawesh as saying that three new "PetroASIA" service stations were opened, raising to nine its total number of service stations in China.
PTT teamed up with PetroASIA International, a unit of Thailand's Charoen Pokphand Group, and Chinese companies in the joint venture.
The statement said monthly sales averaged 200,000-300,000 litres per station with products supplied by Chinese refineries.
PTT International plans to open 50 stations within five years with a 274 million baht ($10.5 million) total investment, it said.
